name: new_v2_manus_speed_with_external_roam_source_rest_v1
rest_source: ROAM subjects 1-18, resting posture, label 0 only, 40-sample 200 Hz pure-label windows after excluding 200 ms at each bout edge; no ROAM validation/final subjects
feature_fit: F0v2 noise thresholds are calibrated on external source-only ROAM Rest windows. F2a and F3c metadata fit the same 8-channel/40-sample source batch. All four classifier scalers/models fit only MANUS Session1 source trials; no MANUS Session2/3 or ROAM held-out signal fits feature state.
classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924, identical to reduced MANUS study
aggregation: mean of at most eight disjoint 200 ms windows per native MANUS recording
selection: maximize pooled Session2 validation macro-F1, break ties by lower pooled validation log loss; Session3 descriptive only
scope: Exact new-v2 four-arm feature formulas with a cross-dataset, source-only Rest-noise prior because MANUS has no Rest label. Myo eight-channel 200 Hz sessions, same six users, six active gestures; speed strata are observed within each session but no unseen-speed intervention. External Rest calibration and changed session make this a qualified speed-axis supplement, not an own-device, live or same-dataset Rest validation.
